claim_text: More than 73,000 people have been killed in Gaza since Israel launched its military campaign after the 7 October 2023 Hamas-led attack that killed about 1,200 people and took 251 hostage, according to the territory's health ministry, whose figures the UN considers reliable.
quote: Israel responded to the attack by launching a military campaign in Gaza, during which more than 73,000 people have been killed, according to the territory's health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN.
confidence_justification: Institutional count carried by the BBC with a UN reliability assessment noted, but still a ministry figure rather than an independent audit.
